summaryEn: Full annual meeting where shareholders approved the move to Texas and Musk's pay package; AI, FSD and Optimus discussed.
summaryZh: 完整年度股东大会，股东在会上批准迁往得克萨斯州以及马斯克的薪酬方案；并讨论了人工智能、FSD 和 Optimus。

segments.textEn: Sa.
segments.textZh: 萨。

segments.textEn: Sam.
segments.textZh: 萨姆。

segments.textEn: Welcome to Texas home.
segments.textZh: 欢迎来到得克萨斯的家。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: The home of tesla.
segments.textZh: Tesla 的家。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: My name is Brandon Earhart. I'm the General Counsel and Corporate Secretary. And this meeting is going to be in two parts. First, we're going to cover the 12 items that stockholders have been asked to vote on, as well as any other matters that have been properly presented. Second, our founder and CEO Elon Musk will provide a presentation.
segments.textZh: 我叫布兰登·埃尔哈特。我是总法律顾问兼公司秘书。本次会议将分为两个部分。首先，我们将审议股东受邀投票表决的12个事项，以及任何其他已适当提交的事项。其次，我们的创始人兼首席执行官埃隆·马斯克将进行演讲。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: During the course of the following sessions, we may discuss our business outlook and make other forward looking statements. Such statements are predictions based on current expectations. Actual events or results could materially differ due to a number of risks and uncertainties, including those disclosed in our most recent 10k or 10q as filed with the SEC. Such forward looking statements represent our views as of today, should should not be relied on hereafter and we disclaim any obligation to update them after today.
segments.textZh: 在接下来的会议过程中，我们可能会讨论我们的业务前景，并作出其他前瞻性陈述。此类陈述是基于当前预期作出的预测。由于多种风险和不确定性，包括我们最近向美国证券交易委员会提交的10-K或10-Q表格中披露的风险和不确定性，实际事件或结果可能存在重大差异。此类前瞻性陈述代表我们截至今天的观点，此后不应不应予以依赖，并且我们不承担在今天之后对其进行更新的任何义务。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: At this time, I'd like to thank members of the Tesla team and the board that are here in attendance. A representative from PricewaterhouseCoopers, Tesla's independent auditor is also present. But before we begin, I'd like to introduce you to our board chair, Robin Denholm, who would like to say a few words.
segments.textZh: 此时，我要感谢到场的Tesla团队成员和董事会成员。Tesla的独立审计师普华永道的一名代表也在场。但在开始之前，我想向大家介绍我们的董事会主席罗宾·德诺姆，她想讲几句话。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: Thanks Brandon. And hello everyone. As chair of Tessa's board, I am honored to welcome you all to our home, Texas for our annual for our annual 2024 annual shareholder meeting. And when I say I'm honored to welcome you, our shareholders, I truly am. No other company in the world has such a diverse, engaged and supportive set of shareholders as Tesla. No other shareholder base understand its company like you do, nor is as committed to Tesla's mission to accelerate the world's transition to sustainable energy like you are.
segments.textZh: 谢谢你，布兰登。大家好。作为Tessa董事会主席，我很荣幸欢迎各位来到我们的家园得克萨斯州，参加我们的年度参加我们的年度2024年度股东大会。当我说很荣幸欢迎各位股东时，我确实是这样想的。世界上没有其他公司像Tesla一样拥有如此多元、积极参与且给予支持的股东群体。没有其他股东群体像你们一样了解自己的公司，也没有哪个股东群体像你们一样致力于Tesla加速世界向可持续能源转型的使命。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: It is a shareholder base whose interests the board are proud to represent. It is also a shareholder base that understands that in order to accelerate the world's transition to sustainable energy and a sustainable energy economy, Tesla needs to develop the most revolutionary technologies. Not only in autos, but in energy and artificial intelligence. And as well, our achievements this past year are steps towards fulfilling our mission.
segments.textZh: 这是董事会自豪地代表其利益的股东群体。这也是一个明白如下道理的股东群体：为了加速世界向可持续能源和可持续能源经济转型，Tesla需要开发最具革命性的技术。不仅是在汽车领域，还包括能源和人工智能领域。而且，我们过去一年的成就是实现我们使命的步骤。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: Some highlights include the Model Y becoming the best selling vehicle in the world in 2023.
segments.textZh: 一些亮点包括Model Y在2023年成为全球最畅销的车辆。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: Beginning deliveries of the much anticipated Cybertruck, proving that the muscle and utility of a pickup truck truck can be electric and cool. And our energy storage deployments reaching an all time high in 2023, with the deployment trend continuing in 2024. By using our products, Tesla customers avoided releasing over 20 million metric tons of greenhouse gas emissions in 2023. That is the equivalent of of 51 billion miles driven by ICE vehicles.
segments.textZh: 开始交付备受期待的Cybertruck，证明皮卡车卡车的力量和实用性也可以是电动且酷炫的。我们的储能部署量在2023年创下历史新高，这一部署趋势在2024年继续延续。通过使用我们的产品，Tesla客户在2023年避免排放了超过2000万公吨的温室气体。这相当于内燃机车辆行驶510亿英里所产生的排放。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: An increase of about 18 billion avoided ICE miles since 2022. But to continue the exponential growth in greenhouse gas emission avoidance, we not only have to get our products into as many customers hands as possible, but we also need to increase the utilization of our products. And to help further with that goal, we released FSD supervised demonstrating that our approach to autonomy is scalable and that accomplishments in artificial intelligence, along with leveraging our existing production lines to get our next generation products to market faster are essential to achieving our mission.
segments.textZh: 自2022年以来，避免的内燃机车辆行驶里程增加了约180亿英里。但要让温室气体减排量继续呈指数级增长，我们不仅必须让尽可能多的客户用上我们的产品，还需要提高我们产品的利用率。为了进一步推动这一目标，我们发布了受监督的FSD，证明我们的自动驾驶方案具有可扩展性，也证明人工智能领域的成就，以及利用我们现有的生产线让下一代产品更快上市，对于实现我们的使命至关重要。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: We have made and plan to make further investments in hardware and software ecosystem to further advance our path to autonomy and set a course to realization of Robo Taxis. But sustainability is not just about avoiding emissions. It needs to take into account the whole life cycle from the manufacturing of the products to the products end of life. That is why we source responsibly, we design our manufacturing processes to use less water per vehicle than the industry average.
segments.textZh: 我们已经并计划在硬件和软件生态系统方面进行进一步投资，以进一步推进我们的自动驾驶之路，并为实现Robo Taxis确定方向。但可持续发展不仅仅是避免排放。它需要考虑从产品制造到产品寿命终结的整个生命周期。这就是我们负责任地采购，并设计制造流程、使每辆车的用水量低于行业平均水平的原因。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: And for the third year in a row, we power our supercharger network with 100% renewables energy.
segments.textZh: 而且，我们连续第3年使用100%可再生能源为超级充电网络供电。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: And we are also working to build a battery material recycling ecosystem both internally and with others to ensure that we are moving towards a truly circular economy for energy storage. In 2023 alone, we supported the recovery of enough battery materials to build 43,000 new rear wheel drive Model Y's. That result is the epitome of a sustainable economy. While sustainability is our mission, we also have the goal of safety.
segments.textZh: 我们也在内部并与其他方合作建立电池材料回收生态系统，以确保我们正朝着真正的储能循环经济迈进。仅在2023年，我们就支持回收了足以制造43,000辆全新后轮驱动Model Y的电池材料。这一成果是可持续经济的典范。虽然可持续发展是我们的使命，但我们也以安全为目标。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: Our cars are engineered to be some of the safest in the world and we take real world data from our fleet and our ability to push over the air updates to optimise safety for all our vehicle models. Our attention to autonomy also plays a role in our goal of safety. Based on 2023 data, Tesla vehicles with driver assist technologies engaged have only a one vehicle accident per 5.64 million miles driven compared to the U.S.
segments.textZh: 我们的汽车经过精心设计，是世界上最安全的汽车之一；我们利用车队的真实世界数据，以及推送无线更新的能力，为我们所有车型优化安全性。我们对自动驾驶的重视也有助于实现我们的安全目标。根据2023年的数据，启用驾驶辅助技术的Tesla车辆每行驶564万英里仅发生1起车辆事故，相较于美国。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: i think it's worth clarifying.
segments.textZh: 我认为这值得澄清。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: Compared to the US vehicle fleet of one accident per 670,000 miles driven. So not only are you protecting the environment by driving a Tesla, you're also protecting yourself and those who ride with you. With another year of progress in furthering our mission under our belt, I want to take this moment to thank our phenomenal Tesla employees whose creativity, hard work and dedication are the source of our success.
segments.textZh: 相比之下，美国车队每行驶670,000英里发生1起事故。所以，驾驶Tesla不仅是在保护环境，也是在保护您自己以及与您同行的人。在推进使命方面又取得了1年的进展之后，我想借此机会感谢我们卓越的Tesla员工，他们的创造力、辛勤工作和奉献精神是我们成功的源泉。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·丹霍姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: As huge thanks and as most as most are also shareholders alongside each and every one of you, I hope each employee takes pride in the role that you have played in Tesla's accomplishments. I am proud of you and the board and I appreciate you tremendously. Finally, I Want to remind our shareholders that your board is listening and we are here to represent your interests. You are. Yes.
segments.textZh: 非常感谢，而且由于大多数、大多数人也和你们每一个人一样是股东，我希望每位员工都为自己在Tesla成就中发挥的作用感到自豪。我为你们和董事会感到骄傲，我非常感激你们。最后，我想提醒我们的股东，你们的董事会正在倾听，我们在这里代表你们的利益。你们是。是的。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·丹霍姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: You are the owners of the company and your voices, your perspectives and your input are critical to us as a board and to the direction of the company. My fellow directors and I serve as your fiduciaries and oversee Tesla's mission, purpose and strategy. With those responsibilities in mind, we continuously set the highest standards for ethical behaviour, corporate citizenship and corporate governance. You don't see the day to day work of the directors, but I can assure you this is a highly engaged board and I would like to thank my fellow directors for their dedication.
segments.textZh: 你们是公司的所有者，你们的声音、观点和意见对我们董事会以及公司的发展方向至关重要。我和其他董事是你们的受托人，并监督Tesla的使命、宗旨和战略。铭记这些责任，我们不断为道德行为、企业公民责任和公司治理设定最高标准。你们看不到董事们日常的工作，但我可以向你们保证，这是一届高度投入的董事会，我要感谢其他董事的奉献。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·丹霍姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: Whether it be inside the boardroom, meeting with our shareholders, or working closely with our team members throughout the company. Tesla is unique. Thank you.
segments.textZh: 无论是在董事会会议室内、与我们的股东会面，还是与公司各处的团队成员密切合作。Tesla是独一无二的。谢谢。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·德诺姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: Tesla is unique in how active and large our retail shareholder base is. And we hope you here in this room and our shareholders joining us virtually today, continue to take advantage of our shareholder platform to enhance your engagement with Tesla. I want to give a special shout out to our small but mighty IR team and legal team and everyone involved in running this year's proxy campaign. Both inside and outside of Tesla.
segments.textZh: Tesla的独特之处在于，我们的散户股东群体既活跃又庞大。我们希望今天在这个会场的各位以及在线参加会议的股东，继续充分利用我们的股东平台，加强你们与Tesla的互动。我要特别感谢我们规模不大但实力强劲的投资者关系团队和法务团队，以及参与开展今年代理权征集活动的每一个人。无论是Tesla内部还是外部的人。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·丹霍姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: There is still much to do, but it has galvanised us around the strong belief that the right things are always worth fighting for. Thank you. And now I'll hand it back. Thank you.
segments.textZh: 仍有许多工作要做，但这让我们更加团结，坚信正确的事情永远值得为之奋斗。谢谢。现在我把时间交回去。谢谢。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·丹霍姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: Now I'm going to hand it back to Brandon. Thank you.
segments.textZh: 现在我要把时间交还给布兰登。谢谢。
segments.speakerZh: 罗宾·丹霍姆（董事会主席）

segments.textEn: Thank you, Robin. So I will now call the meeting to order. The time is now 3:40pm Central and I declared that the polls are now open. We have already received over the past few weeks voting proxies from our stockholders. However, if you wish to vote your shares at this time, you may do so or through the virtual meeting portal or if you want to vote in person. Ballots and ballot boxes are available at the front. Tesla's Board of Directors has appointed Tony Cardidio, a representative of the Cardidio Group, to serve as the inspector of election.
segments.textZh: 谢谢你，罗宾。现在我宣布会议开始。目前时间是美国中部时间下午3:40，我宣布投票现已开始。在过去几周里，我们已经收到了股东提交的投票委托书。不过，如果你们此时希望对自己的股份进行投票，可以通过虚拟会议门户进行投票，或者如果你们想亲自投票，前方备有选票和投票箱。Tesla董事会已任命Cardidio Group的代表托尼·卡迪迪奥担任选举监票人。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: In addition. In addition, Broadridge Financial Services has certified that starting on April 29, 2024, the proxy materials or notice of Internet availability for proxy materials were mailed or provided to all Tesla stockholders of record on April 15, 2024. We have a majority of the outstanding shares represented at the meeting. So I declare that there is a quorum present and that we may proceed with the meeting. The items on the agenda are as follows.
segments.textZh: 此外。此外，Broadridge Financial Services已证实，自2024年4月29日起，代理材料或代理材料互联网可用通知已邮寄或提供给截至2024年4月15日登记在册的所有Tesla股东。出席会议的股份占已发行股份的多数。因此，我宣布出席股份达到法定人数，我们可以继续举行会议。议程项目如下。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: There are five Tesla proposals. The election of two Class 2 directors, James Murdoch and and Kimball Musk, to serve for a term of three years or until their respective successors are duly elected and qualified to approve executive compensation on a non advisory basis. To approve the redomestication of Tesla from Delaware to Texas via conversion.
segments.textZh: 共有5项Tesla提案。选举2名第二类董事，即詹姆斯·默多克和和金巴尔·马斯克，任期3年，或直至他们各自的继任者正式当选并取得任职资格；在非咨询基础上批准高管薪酬。批准通过转换将Tesla的注册地从特拉华州迁至得克萨斯州。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: To ratify the 100% performance based stock option award to Elon Musk that was previously approved by stockholders in 2018.
segments.textZh: 批准此前已由股东于2018年批准、授予埃隆·马斯克的100%基于绩效的股票期权奖励。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: To ratify the appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as Tesla's independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year 2024. Tesla's board has recommended that our stockholders vote for each of the two director nominees and and for each of the four other Tesla proposals. We have also received seven stockholder proposals that are described in the proxy statement. I would like to remind Tesla's board has prepared a statement in opposition to these proposals which also appear in our proxy statement.
segments.textZh: 批准任命PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP为Tesla 2024财年的独立注册公共会计师事务所。Tesla董事会已建议股东投票支持2名董事候选人中的每一位，并并支持其他4项Tesla提案中的每一项。我们还收到了代理声明中所述的7项股东提案。我要提醒各位，Tesla董事会已拟定一份反对这些提案的声明，该声明也载于我们的代理声明中。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: So let's turn to those seven stockholder proposals. The first one is an advisory vote regarding reduction of director terms to one year. Our board has recommended that our stockholders vote against this. As explained in the proxy this proxy this stockholder proposal is proposed by Mr. James McRichey who has prepared a pre recorded message.
segments.textZh: 那么，让我们转到那 7 项股东提案。第一项是关于将董事任期缩短至 1 年的咨询性投票。我们的董事会建议股东对此投反对票。正如委托书这份委托书中所解释的，这项股东提案由詹姆斯·麦克里奇先生提出，他已经准备了一段预先录制的发言。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: Thank you. We presented a similar proposal in 2021. 55% supported it even though the board put up a competing proposal accountability every other year instead of every year. Neither receive the required 67% of shares owned. 90% of the S&P 500 have a declassified board. Most institutional shareholders will again support our proposal. Join them. The recent Delaware court case identified three legal deficiencies at Tesla.
segments.textZh: 谢谢。我们在 2021 年提出过一项类似提案。尽管董事会提出了一项相互竞争的提案，要求每隔 1 年而不是每年进行问责，仍有 55% 的人支持该提案。两项提案获得的支持都没有达到所持股份要求的 67%。标普 500 指数成分公司中有 90% 采用不分级董事会。大多数机构股东将再次支持我们的提案。请加入他们。最近的特拉华州法院案件指出了 Tesla 的 3 项法律缺陷。

segments.textEn: Directors were not independent, the facts of the pay plan presented to investors were misleading and the board failed to negotiate properly. A major part of the cure is declassifying the board so shareholders can hold directors accountable or submit their own nominations. Matt Moscardi of Free Float calls proposal number six the most important vote today since it may enable investors to change the board, bringing new skills and professionalism.
segments.textZh: 董事并不独立，向投资者陈述的薪酬计划事实具有误导性，而且董事会未能进行适当谈判。补救措施的一个主要部分是取消董事会分级制，以便股东能够追究董事责任，或提交自己的提名。Free Float 的马特·莫斯卡迪称第 6 号提案是今天最重要的一票，因为它可能让投资者得以改变董事会，引入新的技能和专业精神。

segments.textEn: John Chavedin's simple majority vote is the other crucial vote. Another important endorser is Nel Minow, co founder of companies including Proxy Advisor iss. The Musk premium is already eroding. Tesla is Musk's liquid piggy bank since it's publicly traded. His other companies are not. Either he sticks around long enough to use our shareholder capital to fund his other ventures or he shifts his attention sooner if we reject his pay package and turn off the money.
segments.textZh: 约翰·查维丁的简单多数票是另一项至关重要的投票。另一位重要的支持者是内尔·米诺，她是包括代理顾问公司 ISS 在内的多家公司的联合创始人。马斯克溢价已经在消退。Tesla 是马斯克的流动存钱罐，因为它是上市公司。他的其他公司不是。要么他留得足够久，利用我们的股东资本为他的其他企业提供资金；要么如果我们否决他的薪酬方案并切断资金，他就会更早转移注意力。

segments.textEn: Tap. Bite the bullet. Prepare for a future that doesn't depend on a superhero dictatorship. Paoli, Trustee of New York State Retirement Fund, owner of Tesla shares valued at over 650 million as of March of this year. And I'm here as a co filer of Proposal 8. Longview Large Cap Fund through its Trustee Amalgamated Bank, AP7 and Arjuna join us in filing this resolution.
segments.textZh: 谢谢。大家好，我是 NEA Impact Capital 的克里斯汀·赫尔博士。我在此代表主要提交方、纽约州审计长托马斯·D·保利，他是纽约州退休基金的受托人；截至今年3月，该基金持有的 Tesla 股票价值超过6.5亿。我也以第8号提案共同提交方的身份来到这里。该基金是 Tesla 的重要长期持有者，并明确专注于投资气候解决方案。Longview Large Cap Fund 通过其受托人 Amalgamated Bank，与 AP7 和 Arjuna 一同参与提交了这项决议。

segments.textEn: Our firm name NIA means intention and purpose. We invest only in those companies we see building toward a better world, a sustainable and inclusive future. As the founder of nia, I had been proud in our early ownership of Tesla, I saw the potential and the need for innovation in the automotive and the clean energy market space. However, when looking under the frunk, we find failures in workplace management one of the most important components of any business.
segments.textZh: 我们公司的名称 NIA 意味着意图和目的。我们只投资于那些我们认为正在建设一个更美好世界、一个可持续且包容的未来的公司。作为 nia 的创始人，我曾为我们早期持有 Tesla 而感到自豪，我看到了汽车和清洁能源市场领域的潜力及创新需求。然而，当我们查看前备箱下面时，却发现了职场管理方面的失败，而这是任何企业最重要的组成部分之一。

segments.textEn: Employees need to be hired, trained, motivated and engaged to do high quality work and we need those employees to be able to contribute to their top ability. To do so, they must feel both physically and emotionally safe at work. Investors are requesting the report outlined in Proposal 8. Because workplace abuse, harassment and discrimination have no place at Tesla. They can result in substantial costs including employee turnover, increased absenteeism and reduced productivity, as well as legal costs, all of which can impact shareholders investments in the company.
segments.textZh: 员工需要被招聘、培训、激励并投入工作，以完成高质量的工作，而我们需要这些员工能够发挥他们的最高能力。要做到这一点，他们必须在工作中感到人身和情绪上都安全。投资者正在要求第8号提案中概述的报告。因为职场虐待、骚扰和歧视在 Tesla 没有容身之地。它们可能造成巨额成本，包括员工流失、缺勤率上升和生产率下降，以及法律费用，所有这些都可能影响股东对公司的投资。

segments.textEn: They may also lead to difficulties in recruiting high quality employees, something that Tesla needs to remain innovative and at the forefront of a quickly moving technological landscape. We have expressed concerns about Tesla's workplace for years and year after year more harassment and discrimination allegations have emerged with few visible improvements in Tesla's people management policies or practices. To assuage our concerns.
segments.textZh: 它们还可能导致招聘高素质员工变得困难，而 Tesla 需要这些员工来保持创新，并处于快速发展的技术格局前沿。多年来，我们一直对 Tesla 的职场表达担忧；年复一年，更多骚扰和歧视指控不断出现，而 Tesla 的人员管理政策或实践几乎没有可见的改善。为了缓解我们的担忧。

segments.textEn: Lawsuits and class actions before Tesla now involved thousands of employees with allegations including repeated use of racial epithets by managers and employees, segregation and discrimination against non white employees in job assignments, pay and promotion, and retaliation when employees report their experiences. These concerns are why I now formally move proposal 8 requesting that Tesla's board commission an independent report on the effectiveness of the company's efforts to prevent harassment and discrimination within this revolutionary and innovative workspace.
segments.textZh: Tesla 目前面临的诉讼和集体诉讼涉及数千名员工，指控包括经理和员工反复使用种族侮辱性称谓、在工作分配、薪酬和晋升方面隔离并歧视非白人员工，以及在员工报告自身经历时进行报复。正是由于这些担忧，我现在正式提出第8号提案，请求 Tesla 董事会委托编制一份独立报告，评估公司在这个革命性、创新性的工作场所中防止骚扰和歧视的工作成效。

segments.textEn: Hello, I'm Tejal Patel, the Executive Director of the SOC Investment Group and I Hereby move proposal 9, a shareholder proposal requesting that Tesla Board of Directors adopt and disclose a non interference and collective bargaining policy that upholds international labor rights standards in its operations. This resolution was submitted with other CO filers and we are concerned that Tesla's existing policy fails to clearly explain how conflicts between international and local labor law will be resolved.
segments.textZh: 大家好，我是 SOC 投资集团执行董事特贾尔·帕特尔，我在此提出第 9 号提案，这是一项股东提案，要求 Tesla 董事会采纳并披露一项不干涉和集体谈判政策，在其运营中维护国际劳工权利标准。本决议由其他共同提交者一同提交，我们担忧 Tesla 的现行政策未能清楚说明国际劳工法与当地劳工法之间的冲突将如何解决。

segments.textEn: And because of clear indications that Tesla is not adhering to its current policy despite the operational, legal, human capital management and reputational risks involved. We recognize that Tesla revised its global human rights policy in April 2023 to explicitly refer to the rights of workers to free association and collective bargaining. But these revisions were fatally compromised. The statement committing to respect these rights includes the qualifier in conformance with local law rather than referencing the often higher international human rights standards suggesting that Tesla respects these rights only as explicitly required by local laws.
segments.textZh: 而且有明确迹象表明，尽管其中涉及运营、法律、人力资本管理和声誉风险，Tesla 仍未遵守其现行政策。我们注意到，Tesla 于 2023 年 4 月修订了其全球人权政策，明确提及工人自由结社和集体谈判的权利。但这些修订受到了致命损害。承诺尊重这些权利的声明包含“遵循当地法律”这一限定语，而非援引往往标准更高的国际人权标准，这表明 Tesla 仅在当地法律明确要求时才尊重这些权利。

segments.textEn: Numerous signs suggest that Tesla is not respecting its workers fundamental rights. In Sweden, Tesla has faced months long strikes and boycotts over what has been characterized as a refusal to bargain. Moreover, as part of its reporting on the situation, Reuters wrote that Tesla has a policy of not signing collective agreements which if true, would directly contravene the company's current policy. In Germany, Tesla faces allegations of refusal to bargain and poor working conditions.
segments.textZh: 许多迹象表明，Tesla没有尊重其员工的基本权利。在瑞典，Tesla因被描述为拒绝谈判的行为，面临了长达数月的罢工和抵制。此外，路透社在有关这一情况的报道中写道，Tesla有一项不签署集体协议的政策，如果属实，这将直接违反公司现行政策。在德国，Tesla面临拒绝谈判和工作条件恶劣的指控。

segments.textEn: In the United States, Tesla has had adverse decisions by the full National Labor Relations board and the U.S. 5th Circuit Court of Appeals over labor rights violations. Just last month the NLRB issued a complaint alleging that restrictions in Tesla's workplace technology policy served to unlawfully discourage employees from joining unions or acting concertedly.
segments.textZh: 在美国，针对劳动权利侵犯问题，Tesla已收到全国劳资关系委员会全体成员和美国第五巡回上诉法院作出的不利裁决。就在上个月，全国劳资关系委员会发出了一份申诉书，指控Tesla工作场所技术政策中的限制措施非法阻碍员工加入工会或采取共同行动。

segments.textEn: It is also relevant for shareholders to consider the broader human capital management risks Tesla faces, including reports of higher health and safety violations and injury rates than peers and numerous lawsuits alleging of hostile work environments. Freedom of association and collective bargaining are considered enabling rights, meaning that they empower workers to effectively advocate for additional labor rights, including the right to a safe and healthy workplace free from discrimination.
segments.textZh: 股东还应考虑Tesla面临的更广泛人力资本管理风险，包括有报道称，其健康与安全违规事件和受伤率高于同行，以及多起指控存在敌意工作环境的诉讼。结社自由和集体谈判被视为赋能性权利，这意味着它们使员工能够有效争取更多劳动权利，包括在不受歧视的安全健康工作场所工作的权利。

segments.textEn: The adoption of a comprehensive labor rights policy that clearly articulates a commitment to non interference, good faith collective bargaining and adherence to higher international standards would help Tesla better mitigate these human capital management risks as well as operational and reputational risks like we are seeing in Sweden. Therefore, we urge you to vote for item nine. Thank you.
segments.textZh: 采纳一项全面的劳动权利政策，明确阐述对不干涉、诚信集体谈判以及遵守更高国际标准的承诺，将有助于Tesla更好地降低这些人力资本管理风险，以及我们在瑞典看到的这类运营和声誉风险。因此，我们敦促各位投票支持第9项议案。谢谢。

segments.textZh: 谢谢您，帕特尔女士。董事会的回应载于委托书。第5项股东提案是就报告电磁辐射和无线技术相关影响与风险进行咨询性投票。基于委托书中所述的理由，我们的董事会建议投反对票。这项股东提案由兰德罗·珀塞尔提出，她有代表出席。黛博拉·戴维斯博士准备了一段预先录制的信息。

segments.textEn: I am Deborah Davis, founder of Environmental Health Trust. I am speaking with you today on behalf of shareholder Landry Purcell regarding her proposal seeking an annual report on the risks for magnetic fields and wireless radiation in their products. I'm also speaking on behalf of millions of young children, infants and toddlers and pre women who are more vulnerable to wireless radiation, according to the American Academy of Pediatrics.
segments.textZh: 我是黛博拉·戴维斯，环境健康信托基金的创始人。今天，我代表股东兰德里·珀塞尔就她提出的提案向各位发言，该提案寻求每年就其产品中的磁场和无线辐射风险发布报告。我也代表数百万幼童、婴儿、学步儿童和孕前女性发言；据美国儿科学会称，这些人更容易受到无线辐射的影响。

segments.textEn: I'm the founding director of the Board on Environmental Studies and Toxicology from the National Academy of Sciences and I published more than 220 scientific articles on environmental health and have concluded, along with hundreds of other experts that current exposures to non ionizing electromagnetic fields called EMF constitute a serious and unrecognized public health risk. Tesla vehicles operate with a 1,200 pound battery that emits magnetic fields and also uses wireless equipment such as WI fi and radar emitting wireless radiation.
segments.textZh: 我是美国国家科学院环境研究与毒理学委员会的创始主任，并已发表超过220篇有关环境健康的科学文章。我与其他数百名专家共同得出结论：目前暴露于被称为EMF的非电离电磁场构成一种严重且未获认识的公共健康风险。Tesla车辆使用一个1,200磅、会发出磁场的电池，还使用Wi-Fi和雷达等会发出无线辐射的无线设备。

segments.textEn: Tesla should provide transparent information on measured exposures and efforts to reduce them. The World Health Organization has concluded that both low levels of EMF and microwave or cellular radiation are are quote, possible carcinogens, the same category as some pesticides and gasoline. The companies that provide secondary insurance, like Lloyd's of London and Swiss Re, have long considered electromagnetic fields to be uninsurable, comparable to asbestos due to potential health and environmental damages.
segments.textZh: Tesla应提供有关实测暴露水平以及降低暴露所做努力的透明信息。世界卫生组织已得出结论，低水平EMF以及微波或蜂窝辐射都是，都是，引用原话，“可能的致癌物”，与某些杀虫剂和汽油属于同一类别。提供再保险的公司，如伦敦劳合社和瑞士再保险，长期以来一直认为电磁场属于不可承保风险，因其潜在的健康和环境损害而可与石棉相提并论。

segments.textEn: Tesla shareholders have a right to know how the company insures itself against such risks. The fact that current levels may be legal does not mean they are safe. In fact, US regulations were set more than a quarter century ago. It has been three years since the U.S. circuit Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia determined that the FCC had been, quote, arbitrary and capricious in its failure to consider all of the science and refusal to update wireless limits, Tesla has failed to inform consumers about the measured level of magnetic fields and wireless radiation within the automobile or or their other products.
segments.textZh: Tesla股东有权知道公司如何就此类风险为自身投保。目前的水平可能合法，但这并不意味着它们是安全的。事实上，美国的法规是在超过四分之一个世纪前制定的。美国哥伦比亚特区巡回上诉法院认定，FCC未能考虑所有科学证据且拒绝更新无线辐射限值是，引用原话，“武断且反复无常的”，至今已有3年。Tesla未能向消费者告知汽车内部或或其其他产品中的磁场和无线辐射实测水平。

segments.textEn: Infants and toddlers by law are strapped into seats to protect them during crashes, but they have no protection from EMF that can go more deeply into their thinner skulls. To mitigate risks for Tesla, the company could shield its vehicles and ensure wireless antennas could be easily turned off. Hardware and software changes can lower exposures. Generally, Tesla has developed extremely rigorous compliance and hazard screenings beyond regulatory requirements for certain toxic chemicals.
segments.textZh: 根据法律规定，婴儿和学步儿童必须被固定在座椅上，以便在碰撞期间保护他们，但他们对于能够更深入穿透其较薄颅骨的EMF却没有任何防护。为降低Tesla的风险，公司可以对其车辆进行屏蔽，并确保无线天线可以轻松关闭。硬件和软件变更可以降低暴露水平。总体而言，对于某些有毒化学品，Tesla已制定超出监管要求的极其严格的合规与危害筛查。

segments.textEn: Investors can encourage the company to take a similar leadership role regarding reducing emf. It's time for the company to unambiguously compete on safety regarding wireless radiation and non ionizing radiation emitted by its products. Thank you.
segments.textZh: 投资者可以鼓励公司在降低EMF方面发挥类似的领导作用。公司是时候在其产品发出的无线辐射和非电离辐射安全方面明确无误地展开竞争了。谢谢。

segments.textEn: Thank you, Dr. Davis. The board's response is set forth in the proxy. Let's move on to the sixth stockholder proposal, which is an advisory vote regarding adopting targets and reporting on metrics to assess the feasibility of integrating sustainability metrics into senior executive compensation plans. Our board has recommended against for the reason set forth in the proxy. This stockholder proposal is proposed by Tulip Share Securities Ltd.
segments.textZh: 谢谢您，戴维斯博士。董事会的回应载于委托书。接下来是第6项股东提案，即就采纳目标并报告相关指标，以评估将可持续发展指标纳入高级管理人员薪酬计划的可行性进行咨询性投票。基于委托书中所述的理由，我们的董事会建议投反对票。这项股东提案由Tulip Share Securities Ltd.提出。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: Whose representative, Constant Ricketts, has prepared a pre recorded message.
segments.textZh: 其代表康斯坦特·里基茨准备了一段预先录制的信息。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: Good afternoon fellow shareholders. Thank you for your time. I'm Constance Ricketts and today I'm speaking on behalf of Tulipshare in support of Proposal 11 urging Tesla to integrate sustainability metrics, including diversity among senior executives, into executive compensation plans. This proposal calls for robust quantitative targets and transparent reporting to both resolve executive pay plan controversies and ensure our company's long term stability and success.
segments.textZh: 各位股东，下午好。感谢各位抽出时间。我是康斯坦丝·里基茨，今天我代表Tulipshare发言，支持第11号提案，敦促Tesla将可持续发展指标，包括高级管理人员的多元化程度，纳入高管薪酬计划。这项提案要求制定有力的量化目标并进行透明报告，从而既解决高管薪酬计划争议，又确保我们公司的长期稳定与成功。

segments.textEn: Diversity and independence in leadership are essential for innovation and enhanced decision making. While sustainability metrics in executive compensation reflect alignment with regulatory pressures, investor expectations and responsible business practices. Despite 75% of S&P 500 companies incorporating sustainability metrics into executive pay plans, Tesla fails to do so. This is especially concerning given our mission to accelerate the world's transition to renewable energy.
segments.textZh: 领导层的多元化和独立性对于创新和增强决策能力至关重要。而高管薪酬中的可持续发展指标反映了与监管压力、投资者预期和负责任商业实践保持一致。尽管75%的标普500指数成分公司已将可持续发展指标纳入高管薪酬计划，Tesla却没有这样做。鉴于我们的使命是加速世界向可再生能源转型，这一点尤其令人担忧。

segments.textEn: The recent ruling that voided our CEOs $56 billion pay package highlighted the need for fair and negotiated compensation plans that serve stockholders best interests. Tesla's proxy statement does not offer substantive evidence of how the voided 2018 award harm stockholder democracy or how its ratification will cure prior deficiencies and lead to a different outcome. Likewise, the opposition to this proposal fails to show any evidence of an existing performance based component integrated into the executive pay structure that respects established human rights, due diligence processes and principles.
segments.textZh: 近期撤销我们首席执行官560亿美元薪酬方案的裁决，凸显了制定公平且经过协商、最符合股东利益的薪酬计划之必要性。Tesla的委托书并未提供实质性证据，说明被撤销的2018年奖励如何损害了股东民主，或批准该奖励将如何纠正先前的缺陷并带来不同结果。同样，对这项提案的反对意见也未能提供任何证据，证明现有高管薪酬结构中已纳入尊重既定人权、尽职调查流程和原则的绩效组成部分。

segments.textEn: Instead, it cites its human rights policy that is wholly unrelated to executive compensation and doubles down on the argument that the currently contested executive pay structure is the only means of motivation to achieve our company's mission. This commitment to the status quo essentially dismisses the ongoing controversies that Tesla must face and overcome, including softening sales, advancing competition, split focus in leadership, a 30% drop in stock price, reduced market cap, mass layoffs, human rights violations and ongoing legal challenges.
segments.textZh: 相反，它援引了其与高管薪酬完全无关的人权政策，并进一步坚持这一论点：目前存在争议的高管薪酬结构是激励实现我们公司使命的唯一手段。这种对现状的坚持，实质上无视了Tesla必须面对并克服的持续争议，包括销售疲软、竞争加剧、领导层精力分散、股价下跌30%、市值减少、大规模裁员、侵犯人权以及持续的法律挑战。

segments.textEn: Tesla's executives absolutely should be duly compensated for innovative and successful business. However, stockholder democracy allows us to oppose demands like 25% control of the company and the largest pay package in corporate American history. Via further share issuance. We also have the right to vote for our leadership's compensation to be commensurate with financial and sustainability performance. This does not mean we do not respect our leadership's time, energy and contributions.
segments.textZh: Tesla 的高管理应因创新且成功的业务获得适当报酬。然而，股东民主制度允许我们反对诸如要求获得公司 25% 的控制权，以及通过进一步发行股票来获得美国企业史上规模最大的薪酬方案。我们也有权投票决定，使领导层的薪酬与财务及可持续发展绩效相称。这并不意味着我们不尊重领导层付出的时间、精力和贡献。

segments.textEn: Quite the contrary, as it is our duty as stockholders to ensure long term viability and success for our company.
segments.textZh: 恰恰相反，因为确保我们公司的长期生存能力与成功是我们作为股东的职责。

segments.textEn: Thank you, Ms. Ricketts. The board's response is set forth in the proxy. Let's move on to the seventh stockholder proposal which is an advisory vote regarding committing to a moratorium on sourcing minerals from deep sea mining. Our board is recommended against for the reasons set forth in the proxy. This proposal is proposed by AS you so, whose representative Elizabeth Levy has also recorded a pre recorded message.
segments.textZh: 谢谢你，里基茨女士。董事会的回应载于委托书。让我们进入第 7 项股东提案，这是一项关于承诺暂停采购来自深海采矿的矿产的咨询性投票。基于委托书中所列的理由，我们的董事会建议投反对票。该提案由 As You Sow 提出，其代表伊丽莎白·利维也录制了一段预先录制的信息。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: Good afternoon Chairman, members of the Board, My name is Elizabeth Levy, representing as you sow, speaking on proposal number 12. We know more about the surface of Mars than we do about the bottom of the ocean. Even so, a new industry is moving forward to exploit the deep sea. We believe this industry poses risks to Tesla now and into the future. Deep sea mining is the process of dredging the ocean floor to extract battery related minerals.
segments.textZh: 下午好，董事长、各位董事会成员，我叫伊丽莎白·利维，代表 As You Sow 就第 12 号提案发言。我们对火星表面的了解，比对海底的了解还要多。即便如此，一个新兴行业正在推进对深海的开发。我们认为，这一行业现在以及未来都会给 Tesla 带来风险。深海采矿是指疏浚海床以提取电池相关矿物的过程。

segments.textEn: It will indiscriminately destroy habitats and obliterate life in its path. Seabed mining could release carbon stores and toxic sediment plumes, poisoning marine food chains and disrupting sea life breeding and migration. The deep sea is complex and abundant with life. Its ecosystems are slow growing and fragile, with little to no ability to recover from outside disturbance. Plans are moving forward to launch the process for commercial scale deep sea mining with or without regulation.
segments.textZh: 它将不加区分地摧毁栖息地，并消灭沿途的生命。海床采矿可能释放储存的碳和有毒沉积物羽流，毒害海洋食物链，并扰乱海洋生物的繁殖和迁徙。深海环境复杂，生命丰富。其生态系统生长缓慢且十分脆弱，几乎没有或完全没有能力从外部干扰中恢复。无论是否受到监管，启动商业规模深海采矿流程的计划都在推进。

segments.textEn: Tesla's membership in the OECD and IRMA mining protocols does not resolve this issue as neither currently applies to mining in the deep sea. Over 800 marine science and policy experts, 25 countries, 72 indigenous groups and 48 companies are calling for a ban, moratorium or precautionary pause on deep sea mining. This includes Tesla's competitors, BMW, Renault, Rivian, Volkswagen and Volvo. Even General Motors has stated it does not plan to use deep sea mine minerals.
segments.textZh: Tesla 加入经合组织（OECD）和负责任采矿保证倡议（IRMA）的采矿协议并不能解决这一问题，因为两者目前都不适用于深海采矿。超过 800 名海洋科学与政策专家、25 个国家、72 个原住民团体和 48 家公司正在呼吁禁止、暂停或预防性暂缓深海采矿。其中包括 Tesla 的竞争对手宝马、雷诺、Rivian、大众和沃尔沃。就连通用汽车也已表示，其不打算使用深海开采的矿物。

segments.textEn: Our company's public stance on deep sea mining matters. Tesla is the face of the EV transition and its ambiguous position on deep sea mining could drive investment in this controversial industry. Conversely, a clear stance restricting Tesla's use of deep sea minerals can drive innovation in battery mineral tech, recycling and circularity. With these technologies, even the most ambitious future EVU scenarios could be met without harming the deep sea.
segments.textZh: 我们公司对深海采矿的公开立场至关重要。Tesla 是电动汽车转型的代表，而其对深海采矿含糊不清的立场可能会推动资金流入这个备受争议的行业。反之，明确表态限制 Tesla 使用深海矿物，则可以推动电池矿物技术、回收利用和循环性的创新。借助这些技术，即使是未来最雄心勃勃的 EVU 情景，也可以在不损害深海的情况下实现。

segments.textEn: Tesla's failure to take a stand on deep sea mining, combined with the fact that a former Tesla board director is now serving as a board member and special advisor to the CEO of the metals company, the very company leading the charge on deep sea mining raises concerns. Such a relationship appears to imply that Tesla supports the metals company in its deep sea mining activities. Committing to a moratorium will clarify expectations and reduce reputational harm to the company, assuring customers and investors that Tesla will indeed wait until science shows deep sea mining will not cause significant or irreparable damage.
segments.textZh: Tesla 未能就深海采矿表明立场，再加上一名前 Tesla 董事会董事如今担任金属公司的董事会成员兼首席执行官特别顾问，而这家公司正是推动深海采矿的领头企业，这引发了担忧。这种关系似乎暗示 Tesla 支持金属公司的深海采矿活动。承诺暂停将明确预期并减少对公司的声誉损害，向客户和投资者保证，Tesla 确实会等到科学表明深海采矿不会造成重大或不可弥补的损害之后再行动。

segments.textEn: Thank you.
segments.textZh: 谢谢。

segments.textEn: Thank you, Ms. Levy. The board's response is set forth in the proxy. Please note that now is the final opportunity to submit any votes in order for them to be counted.
segments.textZh: 谢谢您，利维女士。董事会的回应载于委托书中。请注意，现在是提交任何选票并使其计入统计的最后机会。

segments.textZh: 我宣布，投票现已结束。

With respect to the seven stockholder proposals, our stockholders have approved the recommendations of the Tesla board on all of them, except for Proposal 6 regarding director terms and Proposal 7 regarding simple majority voting.
segments.textZh: 根据我们收到的委托投票以及本次会议提交的投票，我想先行宣布初步结果。关于 7 项股东提案，我们的股东批准了 Tesla 董事会对所有提案的建议，但有关董事任期的第 6 号提案和有关简单多数投票制的第 7 号提案除外。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textZh: 现在转到 Tesla 的 5 项提案。

segments.textZh: 第一，我们的股东批准选举 2 名第二类董事詹姆斯·默多克和金巴尔·马斯克，任期为 3 年，直至各自的继任者正式当选并具备任职资格。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textZh: 第二，我们的股东以不具约束力的咨询方式批准了高管薪酬。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textZh: 第四，我们的股东批准将 Tesla 的注册地从特拉华州迁至得克萨斯州。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: Fifth.
segments.textZh: 第五。

segments.textEn: And finally, our stockholders have approved the ratification of the 100% performance based stock option award to Elon Musk that was approved by stockholders in 2018.
segments.textZh: 最后，我们的股东批准追认 2018 年经股东批准授予埃隆·马斯克的 100% 基于业绩的股票期权奖励。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: The meeting is now closed. And with that, Tesla shareholders, let's welcome Elon Musk.
segments.textZh: 会议现已闭幕。接下来，Tesla 的股东们，让我们欢迎埃隆·马斯克。
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: The goal is to give people hope that there is a path to a fully sustainable global economy. That we are on that path, that we are accelerating that path and that so long as we don't get complacent about it, it will happen.
segments.textZh: 目标是让人们看到希望，相信存在一条通往完全可持续的全球经济的道路。相信我们正走在这条道路上，正加快沿着这条道路前进，而且只要我们不对此自满，它就会实现。

segments.textEn: This was really the beginning of the
segments.textZh: 这确实是……的开端
segments.speakerZh: 布兰登·埃尔哈特（总法律顾问）

segments.textEn: end of the Tesla bubble. I actually think the company could go bust.
segments.textZh: Tesla 泡沫的终结。事实上，我认为这家公司可能会破产。

segments.textZh: Tesla 的 Model Y 是全球最畅销的汽车，超过了丰田的 RAV4 及其卡罗拉车型。

segments.textEn: Regarding FSD version 12, it's profound. The rate of improvement is rapid. It might be the biggest asset value appreciation in history. When you can do unsupervised full self driving, that just sounds like a story stock autonomous taxi. I mean can you really balance your checkbook with, you know, sort of pie in the sky predictions like that? If you ask the wrong question, the right answer is impossible.
segments.textZh: 关于 FSD 第 12 版，它意义深远。改进速度很快。它可能会带来史上最大规模的资产价值增值。当你能够实现无需监督的完全自动驾驶时，这听起来就像是故事股、自动驾驶出租车。我的意思是，你真的能靠这种，你知道，有点不切实际的预测来平衡收支吗？如果你问错了问题，就不可能得到正确答案。

segments.textEn: My prediction is that a majority of Tesla's long term value will be optimus. And that prediction I'm very confident of.
segments.textZh: 我的预测是，Tesla 长期价值的大部分将来自 Optimus。而且我对这个预测非常有信心。

segments.textEn: It's very rare a product comes along that is seemingly impossible, that experts said would never be made. And this is one of those times. Finally the future will look like the future. People say like, why'd you make it bulletproof? I'm like, why not?
segments.textZh: 很少会有一种产品问世，它看似不可能实现，专家们也曾说它永远不可能被制造出来。而这正是其中一次。未来终于会看起来像未来。人们会问，比如，你为什么要把它做成防弹的？我会说，为什么不呢？

segments.textEn: Energy storage deployments, the Megapack in particular reached an all time high in Q1, leading to record profitability for the energy business. This is the machine that builds the machine and the factory is the product. And this building is the most advanced car factory that earth has ever seen.
segments.textZh: 储能部署量，尤其是 Megapack，在第一季度创下历史新高，推动能源业务实现创纪录的盈利能力。这是制造机器的机器，而工厂就是产品。这座建筑是地球上迄今所见最先进的汽车工厂。

segments.textEn: If you value Tesla as an auto company, this is the wrong framework. If somebody doesn't believe Tesla is going to solve Autonomy, I think they should not be an investor in the company. But we will and we are.
segments.textZh: 如果你把 Tesla 当作一家汽车公司来估值，那这个框架就是错的。如果有人不相信 Tesla 将解决自动驾驶问题，我认为他们就不应该成为这家公司的投资者。但我们会做到，而且我们正在做到。

segments.textZh: 而我，我只想首先说一句，真他妈的，我爱你们。

segments.textEn: So, and you know, we've got a great sort of shareholder meeting here to recap the achievements of the company and tell you about where we're going. And it's, I think it's incredible. I think we're not just opening a new chapter for Tesla, we're starting a new book. Okay.
